payload.core_mechanism_summary: Accumulates bull = sum of max(0, a_i - b_{i-1}) over circle, then adds min_i min(a_i, b_{i-1}) as start cost. Single O(n) pass.
payload.rationale: The algorithm selects the starting monster that minimizes required bullets by exchange argument: min(a_i, b_{i-1}) is optimal after paying excess damage, consistent with known greedy proof.
